How it works: A large fixed random recurrent network (reservoir) maps the input into a high-dimensional nonlinear state. Only the linear readout is trained (ridge regression). The reservoir must satisfy the echo state property: spectral radius < 1 (with leaky units). Free-run feeds the model's own prediction back as the next input.
